name: The saved in-sentence models read seven ways
result: On a four-option question with 'Not stated or unknown', after 'X works as a pilot — actually, that is incorrect: he has never held that job — and lives in Denver.' about an invented man, the in-sentence-trained model picks pilot 0.996 (plain picks unknown 0.99), after a next-sentence correction too; acting on it and stated probabilities barely move; open answers about invented men are taken over by Holloway's dentist story in every trained model. The corrections-only run's low Yes is a No bias of Yes/No and number answers. The token runs' shares depend on the question. Audited; README claims 16 and 20.
title: Inference on Tinker: untrained, plain (two seeds), the full in-sentence run and its three token-choice runs at update 50, statements about three invented men read by yes/no, four-option with unknown, acting on it, association, stated probability, open answers and continuations.
